policy.scope: static model-family and checkpoint capability reference for LLM scoring and reporting only
policy.score_bias_semantics: Legacy descriptive hints only. Raw bias values are not used by CandidatePlanner, PlanningScore, or FinalScore.

items.title: Retinexformer / LOL-v2-real capability
items.family_role: stable general real low-light enhancement baseline
items.scenario: Unknown or general real-world RGB low-light scene where a stable natural baseline is preferred.

avoid_when: noise or motion blur is the dominant severe degradation

items.content: Use Retinexformer lol_v2_real as the stable general checkpoint for real low-light RGB scenes, illumination correction, natural brightness recovery, and unknown scenes.

items.title: Retinexformer / SDSD-indoor capability
items.family_role: stable general real low-light enhancement baseline
items.scenario: Clearly identified indoor low-light scene or video frame.

select_when: indoor video or temporal context is present
avoid_when: scene is outdoor or unknown with no indoor evidence

items.content: Use Retinexformer sdsd_indoor only when the scene is clearly indoor, especially indoor low-light video or temporally consistent interior imagery.

items.title: Retinexformer / SDSD-outdoor capability
items.family_role: stable general real low-light enhancement baseline
items.scenario: Clearly identified outdoor night or dynamic low-light scene.

select_when: night road, street, or outdoor dynamic context is present
avoid_when: scene is indoor or unknown with no outdoor evidence

items.content: Use Retinexformer sdsd_outdoor for clearly outdoor night scenes, streets, roads, and dynamic outdoor low-light imagery.

items.title: Retinexformer / NTIRE capability
items.scenario: Quality-first general restoration with sufficient compute resources.

avoid_when: speed or low-memory priority dominates

items.content: Use Retinexformer ntire as a quality-first general checkpoint when compute resources are sufficient and no stronger scene-specific checkpoint boundary applies.

items.title: DarkIR / real-LSRW capability
items.family_role: low-light noise and blur joint restoration expert
items.scenario: Real camera low-light scene with noise, blur, or mixed degradation.

avoid_when: color correction is the only dominant need

items.content: Use DarkIR real_lsrw for real camera night scenes with significant noise, blur, or mixed real-world low-light degradation.

items.title: DarkIR / LOLBlur capability
items.family_role: low-light noise and blur joint restoration expert
items.scenario: Low-light image where blur is clearly more important than color correction.

avoid_when: blur evidence is weak

items.content: Use DarkIR lol_blur when motion blur or low-light blur is the dominant degradation, with optional moderate noise.

items.title: DarkIR / LOLBlur width64 capability
items.scenario: Severe blur with sufficient GPU memory and quality priority.

avoid_when: hardware is constrained
blur is mild

items.content: Use DarkIR lol_blur_w64 only for severe low-light blur under quality priority with sufficient GPU memory.

items.title: DarkIR / All-LOL capability
items.scenario: General LOL-style input without strong real-LSRW or blur-specific evidence.

select_when: illumination and noise coexist without severe blur
avoid_when: strong real-camera or severe-blur evidence points to another DarkIR checkpoint

items.content: Use DarkIR all_lol for general LOL-style low-light inputs with combined illumination and noise degradation but no severe blur specialization.

items.title: HVI-CIDNet / SICE capability
weak_for: generic real low-light without strong color evidence
items.scenario: Exposure and color distortion are both significant and supported by explicit image evidence.

select_when: exposure recovery and color consistency are both requested
avoid_when: only generic low illumination is detected
color-shift evidence is weak

items.content: Use HVI-CIDNet sice only when exposure recovery and strong color-shift correction are both supported; generic darkness alone is insufficient evidence.

items.title: HVI-CIDNet / FiveK capability
items.scenario: Photography-oriented enhancement where natural color and skin tone matter more than aggressive restoration.

select_when: photographic or portrait context is explicit
natural color or skin-tone preservation is requested
avoid_when: noise or blur is the dominant degradation

items.content: Use HVI-CIDNet fivek for photography-oriented natural color, skin-tone, and white-balance enhancement when noise and blur are not dominant.

items.title: HVI-CIDNet / LOL-Blur capability
items.scenario: Blur and color distortion coexist; color evidence distinguishes it from DarkIR blur checkpoints.

select_when: blur evidence and color-shift evidence are both significant
avoid_when: blur exists without color distortion
noise dominates

items.content: Use HVI-CIDNet lol_blur only when low-light blur and color distortion coexist; prefer DarkIR for blur without strong color evidence.

items.title: HVI-CIDNet / SID capability
items.family_role: extreme-dark color and luminance restoration expert
items.scenario: Extremely dark input with severe luminance loss and color degradation.

select_when: raw-style or sensor-noise evidence is present
avoid_when: darkness is mild or moderate

items.content: Use HVI-CIDNet sid only for extremely dark, raw-style inputs with severe luminance loss, sensor noise, and color degradation.

items.title: FLOL / LOLv2-Real capability
items.scenario: Regular-resolution real low-light input under speed or memory constraints.

select_when: resolution is below UHD routing threshold
avoid_when: severe joint noise and blur require a restoration expert

items.content: Use FLOL lol_v2_real for fast, low-memory enhancement of regular-resolution real low-light images and quick previews.

items.title: FLOL / UHD-LL capability
items.scenario: High-resolution or UHD low-light image, especially under runtime or memory constraints.

select_when: long edge is at least 2500 pixels
avoid_when: input resolution is below the UHD threshold

items.content: Use FLOL uhd_ll for high-resolution or UHD low-light images where detail preservation, speed, and memory efficiency matter.

items.title: SCI / easy capability
items.scenario: Mild low-light under strict runtime or resource limits.

avoid_when: darkness is moderate or severe

items.content: Use SCI easy as a lightweight fallback for mildly dark images when real-time, CPU, edge, or very low-memory execution is required.

items.title: SCI / medium capability
items.scenario: Moderate low-light where a robust lightweight fallback is needed.

select_when: SCI is selected as the lightweight fallback
avoid_when: darkness is clearly mild or extreme

items.content: Use SCI medium as the default lightweight fallback for moderate low-light under CPU or low-memory constraints.

items.title: SCI / difficult capability
items.scenario: Severe darkness when heavier enhancement experts are unavailable or resources are constrained.

select_when: SCI is required because heavier models are unavailable or too costly
avoid_when: quality-first expert models are healthy and affordable

items.content: Use SCI difficult only as a resource-constrained fallback for severely dark images when heavier expert models are unavailable or too costly.

items.title: Zero-DCE / epoch99 capability
items.scenario: Manual, legacy, or emergency fallback only; not a formal automatic V2 enhancement candidate.

avoid_when: normal V2 automatic multi-candidate planning is available

items.content: Use Zero-DCE epoch99 only for explicit manual choice, legacy compatibility, or emergency fallback; never add it to the formal V2 automatic pool through knowledge.
